diagnoses.description: LibreOffice macro is written into the user profile (user macros) but recalc.py invokes it with `location=application`, which targets application-installed macros instead of user macros. This mismatch can prevent the macro from being found/executed, causing formula recalculation to fail even when the macro file exists.

locations.section: recalc(): cmd macro URL uses `vnd.sun.star.script:Standard.Module1.RecalculateAndSave?language=Basic&location=application` while setup_libreoffice_macro() writes to the user profile macro directory
